notes.title: Thank you for playing! We're working on fixes.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829083/4c0d7c76bc0c0465b8c8bde6668f34f911239455.png[/img]

We're getting information about small bugs from our players!
We want to announce that our team has already started fixing them. Please send us information about the issues you encounter!

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: The game is out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829083/68b996f94b30dbae9232aa41e87e543cce8a6a89.png[/img]

The game is officially out! 
You can finally dive into the colorful world of [b]CyberCity[/b]!

We can't wait to see you adventures on a street of our Cyberpunk styled city!

notes.title: 60 minutes until the game releases!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829083/30afafaac8bd5f4f71434e77bfd218f8644b0913.png[/img]

[h3]It is happening! 
The game is going to be released in [b]60[/b] minutes from this moment!
We hope that you will be there with us - you can't miss it!

It's the final countdown! [/h3]

notes.title: We love cyberpunk as much as you do and we really want to give you the best...
notes.content:
We would like to apologise for the delay of the game. It is all our fault. ːsteamsadː ːsteamsadː  ːsteamsadː  ːsteamsadː  ːsteamsadː  ːsteamsadː  ːsteamsadː  ːsteamsadː  ːsteamsadː  


We love cyberpunk as much as you do and we really want to give you the best possible experience we can but in order to do that we need a little bit more time. 
We are going to give our very best to release the game at Tuesday 17.12.19 and to make up for our lateness we promise that for each day of delay the price of the game will be reduced by 5%. To sum it up, the game is going to have 20% price drop (5% cut for Saturday, 5% cut Sunday and 5% cut Monday plus 5% cut more as a gift from us).


We are reeeeelyyyyy soooryyyy!!!!!

Buuut ARE YOU READY!!!!!! ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Premiere Tomorrow!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829083/35389ae39e5622a9bd4ab2f9bf5de1cdfba2ec73.png[/img]
Thank you for your interest and support! 
We know that you look forward to the release of the game but saddly it is going to be available tomorrow - [b]15.12.2019[/b]. 
Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Cyber City releases Tomorrow!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829083/929131eb19fcc26a2d1fba26615baafcbf5166a4.png[/img]

It is approximately [b]24 hours[/b] left now until the game officially released!
This Saturday is going to be unforgettable. 
We do hope that you will be there with us tomorrow!

notes.title: RELEASE DATE!!! 14.12.2019!!!
notes.content:
We are very happy to officially announce the release date of our game.

Cyber city will be released on December 14th!!!
It's only 5 days left!!!

Look forward to the new trailer and announcements.

[previewyoutube=Gg9qPjpc0nE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New trailer!
notes.content:
We've been working on the game very hard recently.

The game is about to release very very soon. 
We've made a new trailer. You can watch it on our steam page. 

Expect more news in the [b]upcoming [/b] days!

notes.title: Cyber City - Cyberspace racing & Arena battles showcase
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ZBGcn-sEcvQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]Cyberspace Racing & Arena Battles Showcase[/b][/h1]

We're happy to give you a little look on how Cyberspace Racing and Arena Batteling will look like. 

First of all - a big thank you to all of you. Your support and ideas are constantly beeing implemented into the game and some things in this teaser wouldn't be there if you'd not suggest your concepts. 

Please take a note that this is not the final build of game. It might differ from how it is going to look like in final game. 

More detailed informations about those two features are going to be discoussed on our social media soon, so be sure to follow us there so you don't miss any news!
